title: Scheduled Large-Item Delivery Appointment Changes — Northgate Store and Online Orders
content:
**Scope.** This governs a customer's change of the delivery appointment of a Northgate Scheduled Large-Item Delivery order under **Northgate Store and Online Orders**.

A Scheduled Large-Item Delivery appointment may be rescheduled by the customer at any time down to the scheduled day itself, whatever tender paid the order: the program's free reschedules made two or more days ahead carry no fee, and every other reschedule carries the late-change fee this rule sets; this sentence covers reschedules only, and a cancellation stays under the cancellation rules.

For a customer's reschedule of a Scheduled Large-Item Delivery appointment, and only for such a reschedule, the late-change fee is the amount this rule works out, whatever tender paid the order; a large-item order canceled within the cutoff hours of its scheduled date, beyond the free reschedules, still carries the program's late cancellation fee.

**What a reschedule records.** The rescheduling is the customer's own decision, recorded as a reschedule request and confirmed by the customer. When a customer reschedules, the new date is recorded on the order, the reschedule count goes up by one, and the late-change fee is charged on the order as a fee of the late cancellation type with no waiver source; a reschedule that owes no late-change fee books no fee row.

**Tender.** The late-change fee is the same whatever tender paid the order. It is booked at the care desk only on an order paid in full by an external card with no Northgate Cash or gift card redeemed on it. On every other order the same late-change fee applies; its posting to the Northgate Card, Northgate Cash or gift card ledger is made by a human representative to whom the customer is handed over with the reason policy not covered, and nothing is booked at the care desk.

**When the late-change fee is fixed.**
- On an order paid in full by an external card with no Northgate Cash or gift card redeemed on it, the late-change fee is fixed only after the records carry the missed-appointment credit owed on a large-item delivery fee charged above zero for an order on which Northgate itself moved an appointment.
- On an order paid in full by an external card with no Northgate Cash or gift card redeemed on it, the late-change fee is not fixed until the records carry the replacement haul-away credit owed on a haul-away charge above zero of an order placed zero to ninety days after a Northgate Protect claim settlement that replaced or reimbursed an item of a merchandise category the order carries.
- On an order paid in full by an external card with no Northgate Cash or gift card redeemed on it, before the late-change fee is fixed, the records must carry the late-change goodwill refund owed on the latest late-change fee row with an amount above 0.00 on an order on which Northgate itself moved an appointment.

**Invocation — `reschedule_large_item_delivery_d930ab59`.** This is the customer's own tool. The agent unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it. One call records the customer's confirmed reschedule request on the order, sets the order's scheduled delivery date to the new date, raises the order's reschedule count by one and, when the fee is above 0.00, charges it on the order as a late-change fee paid by the external payment card on file for the order, adding it to the net amount paid on the order; a 0.00 fee charges nothing and books no fee. The customer sees the new delivery date and the fee on the order at once. An order not paid in full by an external card, or with Northgate Cash or a gift card redeemed on it, is refused and nothing is recorded.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `order_id` | the reference number of the customer's Scheduled Large-Item Delivery order whose appointment is being moved, read from the customer's order lookup | identifier |
| `new_scheduled_date` | the new delivery date the customer chooses | YYYY-MM-DD, a calendar date in the store's local time zone, no time part; must be a valid calendar date |
| `late_change_fee_usd` | the late-change fee charged for this change | US dollars, a non-negative number with at most 2 decimal places, already rounded half up to the cent; 0.00 when no fee is owed |

**Return.** A text starting with "Rescheduled" means the change and the fee are recorded; it gives `request_id` (the confirmed reschedule request), `order_id`, `scheduled_date` (the new date), `reschedule_count` (the count after this change), `fee_event_id` (the late-change fee charge, or none when no fee was charged) and `late_change_fee_usd` (with 2 decimals). A text starting with "Error:" means nothing was recorded: a date not written as YYYY-MM-DD, a fee that is negative or has more than 2 decimal places, an order that does not exist, or an order refused on its tender.
